tools/delivery_bootstrap.py.bound: Working-tree bootstrap source; the deliver job runs the literal bootstrap commit pinned in its checkout step, bound by that step digest. tools/delivery_runtime.py.bound: Candidate runtime imported by the exported tools/deliver.py after a passing verdict; slot selection uses the pinned bootstrap sibling. Fixed Hexalith origins, validated names, CAPACITY=17, bounded Git/HTTP and token budgets; registry and installation selection guards.

tools/deliver.py.bound: Accepted-source module application; no change to validation verdict or product gates.

tools/nightly.py.bound: At most 17 committed registry modules plus fixed Builds; slots, polls and handoff inventories validated against those identities.

tools/nightly_runtime.py.bound: Only CiCd, Builds and validated registered module identities; bounded API, state and token use.

tools/nightly_publish.py.bound: Only authenticated successful nightly targets can be published with the selected per-target token.

tools/nightly_delivery_wait.py.bound: Actions read only for CiCd plus committed validated registered modules, maximum 17 module identities.

tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py.bound: Only Projects; closed catalog and ci-gates profiles with separate exact paths and absent full-writer target.

tools/deliver_contracts_prerequisites.py.bound: Four closed profiles: EventStore publisher, Projects publisher, Projects pins, Projects prerequisite policy; no caller-supplied repository.

tools/propose_eventstore_contracts_prere.bound: Only EventStore fixed cicd/contracts-prerequisite-eventstore branch and optional draft PR, no main write or publication.

tools/dispatch_contracts_prerequisite.py.bound: Only eventstore/projects owner choices and publish/verify operations selecting approved existing release.yml profiles.
